description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Brand''' sets the target enemy aflame, which creates a blast that deals magic damage to them and causes the flame to spread from the target to nearby enemies, dealing them the same damage.
description.text: Active: Brand sets the target enemy aflame, which creates a blast that deals magic damage to them and causes the flame to spread from the target to nearby enemies, dealing them the same damage.

notes.raw: * The flame spreads to enemies near the primary target at the time of cast. ** Enemies that move out of range after the fact will still be hit, as the flame is spread as homing missiles to each of its targets. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
The flame spreads to enemies near the primary target at the time of cast.
* Enemies that move out of range after the fact will still be hit, as the flame is spread as homing missiles to each of its targets.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
